I can see the vulnerability. In `read_mft_common`, the code reads `mftTag->grid_points[0]` (a single byte) and assigns it to `a2b->grid_points[i]` for each input channel. But `a2b->grid_points` is an array of size 1 (from line 369: `uint8_t grid_points [1];`). So if `input_channels > 1`, writing to `a2b->grid_points[i]` for `i >= 1` is an out-of-bounds write.
